Notes: Clan Field Surgeon Elsa Oosta (CLFI), ICC Shuttleport. Rebuilt from 8 QuestDialogCapture dumps (Clan_Field_Surgeon_Elsa_Oosta_CLFI, 2026-10-20, characters Soldmen, Complicado). PPK6 (Talk to the Medic) completes on open; S4WX > 6PMI > IIG3 scanner chain, IIG3 is the Meta Roentgen Scanner (MERO) trade; the injury report gives M78S. Retail re-gave S4WX even when it was already done, so the scanner line is not guarded. A Soldmen capture also completed an unresolved quest '?Talk_to_the_Clan_Field_Surge___' on open (no hash in Quests.json), which is not scripted.

help.Text: Is there anything I can do to help?

no_thanks.Text: No thanks!...I don't have a death wish.

have_scanner.Text: I'm back again!  I have the scanner for you.

report.Text: Uhmm..Travis Molen wanted a report from you.

Text: {completequest PPK6}
{delay 1}Oh!  Hello there.
{delay 2}\nHave you been hurt in the crash?
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa Takes a close look at you, checking for injuries.{/emote}
{delay 3}Thank goodness, you seem to be ok.
{delay 2}\nYou are one of the lucky ones today...
{delay 2}\nBetween the shuttle crash victims and the soldier's injuries I am almost at the end of my rope...not to mention my resources.
{delay 1}Oh!  Hello there.
{delay 2}\nHave you been hurt in the crash?
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa Takes a close look at you, checking for injuries.{/emote}
{delay 3}Thank goodness, you seem to be ok.
{delay 2}\nYou are one of the lucky ones today...
{delay 2}\nBetween the shuttle crash victims and the soldier's injuries I am almost at the end of my rope...not to mention my resources.
The Unicorn Company were here earlier killing off the heavy invaders.
{delay 3}{emote}Elsa looks around to make sure no one is listening{/emote}
{delay 2}...and anyone else that got in the way..
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa looks out over the battle{/emote}
{delay 3}Once their ''Corporate Directive'' was complete they jumped on their ships and left the spaceport soldiers and guards to try and clean up the mess.
{delay 5} \nThey do that all the time...
{delay 2}\nOmni-Tek only wants to ''Protect their investment.''
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa looks around again and whispers.{/emote}
{delay 2}I'm glad they're gone though...those guys will do ANYTHING to get their job done.
{delay 3}\nThey don't care who gets hurt, or what they have to do.
I'm trying to keep ahead of the injuries to the guards and soldiers and trying to make sure you colonists all arrived ok.
{delay 4}\nThere were only 11 new colonists on board according to the ships list, but I have seen 13 of you so far...
{delay 3}\nI'm not sure I'm going to have enough healing kits for all of you.
That would be great, if it's not too much trouble.
{delay 2}\nThe heal kits I got from the supply manager don't seem to be healing the soldiers very well..
{delay 3}\nI suspect the energy field around the aliens is hurting the soldiers on a different nano frequency.
{delay 3}{emote}She wrinkles her nose and smiles.{/emote}
{delay 2}If you could scan one of the aliens on the northwest end of the island it would be a big help.
{delay 3}\nThen I could compare it to a scan of a normal Rubi-Ka lifeform.
{delay 2}\nThat might just work!
{delay 1}\nI might be able to make better healing kits with the data you collect.
{delay 2}\nCan you help me?
I'm sorry you feel that way...
{delay 2}\nAnyways...
{delay 1}\nI'm really busy, so if you can't find it in your heart to help I can't spend any more time with you.
{delay 3}{emote}She returns to watching over the soldiers.{/emote}
Great!
{delay 2}\nVery nice of you!
{delay 2}\nHere is the scanner.
{givequest S4WX}
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa gives you the scanner.{/emote}
{delay 2}The scanner will automatically update information about the creatures you target. When you have scanned the Alien Spider and the Reef Salamander bring the scanner back to me.
{delay 2}\nI'd love to see the data, and I hope we can use it to make some better healkits for these poor soldiers!
{delay 3}\nGood luck...and be careful!
Great!  Let me have a look at it.
{delay 2}{emote}Elsa smiles{/emote}
{completequest IIG3}
{delay 1}{emote}Elsa removes a small memory chip from the scanner and looks at it carefully.{/emote}
{delay 3}Yes...this could work quite well.
{delay 2}\nI think we might have something here.
{delay 2}\nWith this information I should be able to end some of the senseless suffering here today!
{delay 3}\nGood work, {player}!
{delay 2}\nYou deserve a reward for your selfless efforts!
{delay 1}\nI don't have much to offer, but here you go!
{delay 2}\nLet me know if there is anything else you need.
Oops!
{delay 1}\nOf course Travis would want to know how things are going.
{delay 1}{givequest M78S}
{emote}Elsa gives you the injury report.{/emote}
{delay 2}\nThanks again for all your help!

want_scanner.Text: Can I have the scanner please?
